title: Excavations at Portchester Castle
summary: This is an account of excavations at Portchester Castle which took place under Barry Cunliffe in 1961–72. The volume deals with Roman features and material recovered from these excavations. Included are descriptions of structures representing the shore fort and specialist reports on the material recovered, including pottery, coins, metalwork, human and animal bones, and archaeobotanical remains. A concluding chapter summarizes the results of the work in a historical and regional perspective.
